final: WITH counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT AVG(transaction_count) AS average_count, SUM(transaction_count) AS total_count FROM counts) SELECT SUM(c.transaction_count) AS sum_of_counts, AVG(1.0 * c.transaction_count / totals.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(c.transaction_count - totals.average_count) AS average_excess FROM counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals WHERE c.transaction_count > totals.average_count
